definitions.full: H586. anachna אֲנַ֫חְנָא ( Ezra 4:16 אֲנַ֫חְנָה ) pronoun 1 plural we (Egyptian Aramaic RES 361 S-C Pap. אנחנה ; Biblical Hebrew אֲנַחְנוּ ; W CG 100 f. ), Dan 3:16-17 , Ezra 4:16 (after participle), 5:11 .

occurrences.englishText: We inform the king that, if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
